title.narrative: Rehabilitation of the Mittaphab Hospital in Lao PDR

description.narrative: This is the second phase of a project funded by the Russian Federation in Lao PDR. The Soviet Union supported the construction of the Mittaphab (Friendship) Hospital in Vientiane, Lao PDR in the 1960s. In 2017, UNOPS and the Russian Federation signed an agreement on the development of the feasibility study to identify the needs of the hospital for the potential reconstruction, which served as the first phase of the project in the form of feasibility studies. In December 2021, the Russian Federation confirmed that funding was secured to proceed with the rehabilitation of the hospital based on the findings of the feasibility studies.
